share.groups.label: Shared Session Groups
share.groups.help: Required source publication boundary: publish only sessions in these exact groups. The optional person filter narrows them further. Missing or empty groups publish nothing.

share.involvingProfileId.label: Involving Person
share.involvingProfileId.help: Optional exact source-local profile ID (including merge aliases). Narrows the required shared groups to canonical owners or profile participants. Mentions alone, names, and logins do not match.

nodes.label: Paired Nodes
nodes.help: Receiver-owned source links and display attribution keyed by paired node id. These settings never grant session access.

nodes.*.controlUiOrigin.label: Source Control UI Origin
nodes.*.controlUiOrigin.help: Optional HTTP(S) origin for Open original, such as https://team.example.com. No credentials, path, query, or fragment. Opens a separate authenticated connection to the source.

nodes.*.controlUiBasePath.label: Source Control UI Base Path
nodes.*.controlUiBasePath.help: Optional source path prefix for Open original, such as /openclaw. Defaults to root. Receiver-owned; never inferred from this Gateway or source session rows. No query, fragment, whitespace, or dot segments.

nodes.*.owner.label: Default Owner
nodes.*.owner.help: Local display owner for unattributed sessions: github:<login> or profile:<profileId>.

nodes.*.linkGitHubIdentities.label: Link GitHub Identities
nodes.*.linkGitHubIdentities.help: Trust this paired node's numeric GitHub account claims for local profile display attribution. Off by default.
